Plans.Filter: (((r.object_key ~ '^(models|audits)/'::text) AND (o.object_key IS NOT NULL)) OR ((r.completed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (r.recovery_until IS NOT NULL) AND (r.recovery_due <= clock_timestamp()) AND (r.remove_after <= clock_timestamp())))

selectionProof.productionSql:
WITH due AS MATERIALIZED (
   SELECT r.object_key,r.recovery_due AS sort_at FROM fs138.object_removals r
   WHERE r.completed_at IS NOT NULL AND r.recovery_until IS NOT NULL
    AND r.recovery_due<=now() AND r.remove_after<=now()
   ORDER BY r.recovery_due,r.object_key LIMIT 1024
  ), adoption AS MATERIALIZED (
   SELECT r.object_key,o.first_seen AS sort_at FROM fs138.orphan_observations o
   JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT object_key FROM fs138.object_removals r WHERE r.object_key=o.object_key LIMIT 1
   ) r ON true
   WHERE o.object_key ~ '^(models|audits)/'
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM due d WHERE d.object_key=o.object_key)
   ORDER BY o.first_seen,o.object_key LIMIT 1024
  ) SELECT object_key FROM (
   SELECT object_key,sort_at,0 AS lane FROM due
   UNION ALL SELECT object_key,sort_at,1 AS lane FROM adoption
  ) candidates ORDER BY lane,sort_at,object_key LIMIT 1024
